items.reason: Catalog.razor catches its own facets failure, but CatalogSearch independently awaits the same endpoint without handling failure. This violates the criterion that a failed facets call leaves the page working with the range omitted.
items.fix: Handle facets failure in the sidebar too, or share the safely loaded facets result, so unavailable facets cannot abort catalog rendering.
